short: binary-level integration tests with a fake gh and a fake curl
is: Integration tests that run the built zaf binary in a temp project against a scripted fake gh and, for slices, a throwaway jj repository with a bare remote. Three crates read no binary: architecture.rs holds the layers to their imports, board_contract.rs checks every Board backend the same way, and forge_contract.rs takes one pull request through the Forgejo forge on a real instance.
conventions: Each test crate does `mod common;` and builds a Project (temp root, .zaf.toml, gh scene) from common/mod.rs

fs.name: architecture.rs
fs.role: each layer names only the crate modules it may; the domain names none outside itself

fs.name: board_contract.rs
fs.role: the Board contract over an Arrange trait: always on FakeBoard, on GitHub issues when ZAF_CONTRACT_REPO names a scratch repo (and a Project with ZAF_CONTRACT_PROJECT), on Forgejo when ZAF_CONTRACT_FORGEJO_URL, _REPO and _TOKEN_ENV name an instance, a scratch repo and the variable holding its token

fs.name: cli_board.rs
fs.role: board verbs: terse and JSON forms, exits 0, 1, 2

fs.name: cli_forge.rs
fs.role: zaf forge verbs on a GitHub forge (fake gh) and a Forgejo one (fake curl): what each prints, exits 0, 1, 2

fs.name: cli_slice.rs
fs.role: slice open, changes, slice pr, slice merge end to end

fs.name: common/
fs.role: shared Project harness, jj helper, the fake curl scene (Curl) and path_with_zaf, which puts the built zaf on PATH for actions that call zaf

fs.name: fixtures/
fs.role: gh: fake gh shell script; forgejo/curl: fake curl for the Forgejo adapter

fs.name: forge_contract.rs
fs.role: the Forgejo forge on a real instance when ZAF_CONTRACT_FORGEJO_URL, _REPO and _TOKEN_ENV are set: a new branch, a pull request opened, a pending then a passing status, the hand-off, the merge; the branch deleted after

fs.name: spawn_phase.rs
fs.role: spawn phase: the caller does not wait, the run sees ZAF_RUN, ZAF_SIZE and ZAF_INSTANCE, a non-current or running phase is refused, a started phase reads Running

fs.name: ways_manifest.rs
fs.role: the ways repo's own .zaf.toml loads, ZAF.toml is gone, and doctor finds every needed action in the project tier with no machine dependency

notes: fixtures/gh reads a FAKE_GH_DIR scene: a rules file of glob, exit code and response file; calls/ records each argv; an unmatched call exits 97
src/adapters/github/tests.rs also uses fixtures/gh, so it is shared with unit tests

fixtures/forgejo/curl reads a FAKE_CURL_DIR scene: a rules file of a glob over METHOD URL, an HTTP status (or curl:<code>; a trailing ! answers once) and response file; calls/ records each argv and the config curl read on stdin; src/adapters/forgejo/tests.rs, cli_forge.rs and ways_ci_wait.rs use it
board_contract.rs and forge_contract.rs reach the network only when their variables are set: gh for GitHub, the Forgejo instance for Forgejo
cli_slice needs a real jj on PATH
